disambiguation: Not a full project management suite; it focuses strictly on GTD principles and Markdown compatibility.

intentEvidence: The calm GTD app inside Obsidian.
problem: Users need a structured way to manage tasks and deadlines within Markdown notes without relying on complex database queries or losing the simplicity of plain text.
summary: A GTD-style task manager that uses six fixed views and natural language parsing over standard Markdown checkboxes.
